results.label: this tree ships the M110 news-window module (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the shipped dialog has two separate news inputs, before and after, and no single “news window” control
the view source carries no `windowMin` and no bare `window_min` in the news payload: it sends the two keys and nothing else
the dialog text tells the trader the settle floor is 30 and that the two are separate clocks, before anything is typed
the accounts pane renders an Add-account action that opens the dialog (so the fields are reachable, not dead markup)
the dialog opens as “New account” and shows the two news fields
a new account is offered the shipped defaults 15 / 45, not one number and not an empty box
the inputs’ own bounds match the server’s: the block 1–240, the settle 30–240 (the floor is the same in both places)
the two labels name the SIDE each number governs, so they cannot be read as one symmetric window
a settle below the floor is refused in the dialog with the floor named, and nothing is sent to the server
a block under 1 minute is refused too, and still nothing is sent
a value he actually sanctions (5) is accepted by the dialog and sent as 5, never rewritten to 15 and never spread onto the settle
and the payload has both keys and no third news key, so the single-knob shape cannot come back through the UI
saving closes the dialog and reports success once
the server stored that pair for this account, so the dialog and the engine read the same two numbers
the pane offers an edit action per account, addressed by the account’s own id
editing that account reopens the dialog with the STORED pair (5 / 45), not the schema defaults — a saved value is not silently reset on the next open
the edit dialog is titled as an edit, so the pair above is not read as a new-account default
raising only the settle sends the untouched block (5) alongside it — the two clocks travel together and neither is inferred
the raised settle is what the account now carries, and the block did not move
the edit dialog for that account still shows 5 / 60 after a re-render, so a reload does not re-derive the pair
renaming the account through the same dialog leaves both clocks exactly where they were
no uncaught error was raised by any interaction, and nothing was rendered through innerHTML

scope: M110 real DOM: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock and a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser; two asymmetric news clocks, no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
